correctness.rationale: The exact full-field verifier proves geometric smoothness by a Gröbner Jacobian argument, recovers the sixty-line coordinate orbit and its 30 Frobenius pairs, and derives the 20-dimensional nondegenerate divisor span from the intersection matrix. It computes rank ten for the Frobenius invariant span and exactly 20 and 554 rational points by complete normalized projective enumeration. Standard K3 H² dimension 22 and the Lefschetz trace formula yield the quadratic factor 1−3T+16T². The discriminant −55 ensures no additional algebraic eigenclasses; normalized 2-adic slopes establish ordinarity. This is not an extrapolation from a sample.
